news.h: Rams' Myles Garrett to be activated from injured reserve, play vs. Commanders
news.d: Rams star pass rusher Myles Garrett is on track to be activated from injured reserve ahead of Sunday's game at the Commanders.

news.h: Myles Garrett will return to practice this week for Los Angeles Rams
news.d: Los Angeles Rams star pass rusher Myles Garrett, who has been on injured reserve since having arthroscopic knee surgery in mid-September, will return to practice this week, coach Sean McVay told reporters Monday.

news.h: How active NFL players continue to redefine all-time sack list
news.d: Myles Garrett's torrid pace up the all-time sack list paces active players making their moves among the greats.

news.h: Rams' DE Garrett, TE Ferguson won't practice this week
news.d: Rams pass rusher Myles Garrett (knee) and tight end Terrance Ferguson (ankle) will not return to practice this week, coach Sean McVay said Wednesday.
